question: A takes 24 days to finish a work and B takes 6 days for the same work. In how many days can A and B finish it together?
explanation:
Take the LCM as total work.
\[
W=LCM(24,6)=24
\]
Find each worker's one-period efficiency.
\[
A=24/24=1,\quad B=24/6=4
\]
Divide total work by the combined efficiency.
\[
T=\frac{24}{1+4}=4.8
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=\frac{24\times 6}{24+6}=4.8
\]
Answer: 4 4/5 days
explanationHi:
कुल काम के लिए LCM लें।
\[
W=LCM(24,6)=24
\]
प्रत्येक मजदूर की एक-अवधि दक्षता निकालें।
\[
A=24/24=1,\quad B=24/6=4
\]
कुल काम को संयुक्त दक्षता से भाग दें।
\[
T=\frac{24}{1+4}=4.8
\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:
\[
T=\frac{24\times 6}{24+6}=4.8
\]
उत्तर: 4 4/5 दिन

question: A team can complete a job in 15 days. If it works for 10 days, what fraction of the job will still be unfinished?
explanation:
Set up the rate relation for this case.
\[
R=1-\frac{t}{T}
\]
Put the given values into that relation.
\[
R=1-\frac{10}{15}
\]
Solve for the asked value.
\[
R=\frac{5}{15}=1/3
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
R=\frac{15-10}{15}=1/3
\]
Answer: 1/3

explanation:
Set up the rate relation for this case.
\[
W=(a+b)T
\]
Put the given values into that relation.
\[
W=(4+5)\times 10
\]
Solve for the asked value.
\[
T_A=\frac{90}{4}=22.5
\]

\[
T_A=\frac{(a+b)T}{a}=\frac{(4+5)10}{4}=22.5
\]
Answer: 22 1/2 days

question: 15 workers finish a job in 16 days, working 6 hours daily. How many workers should work 8 hours daily to finish it in 12 days?
explanation:
Set up the rate relation for this case.
\[
M_1D_1H_1=M_2D_2H_2
\]
Put the given values into that relation.
\[
15\times 16\times 6=M_2\times 12\times 8
\]
Solve for the asked value.
\[
M_2=15
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
M_2=\frac{15\times 16\times 6}{12\times 8}=15
\]
Answer: 15 workers

question: A begins a job alone. A can finish it in 30 days and B can finish it in 12 days. If B joins after 3 days, when will the job be completed from the start?
explanation:
Split the work into timeline phases.
\[
W_1=r_At_1,\ T_2=\frac{W-W_1}{r_A+r_B}
\]
Subtract the work already completed.
\[
W_1=2\times 3,\quad R=60-6
\]
Use the active rate for the remaining phase.
\[
T=3+\frac{54}{2+5}=10.71
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=3+\frac{60-2\times 3}{2+5}
\]
Answer: 10.71 days

\]

\[
W_1=2\times 3,\quad R=60-6
\]
शेष चरण के लिए सक्रिय दर लगाएँ।
\[
T=3+\frac{54}{2+5}=10.71
\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:
\[
T=3+\frac{60-2\times 3}{2+5}
\]
उत्तर: 10.71 दिन

stem.pa: A ਕੰਮ 30 ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਤੇ B 12 ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। A ਇਕੱਲਾ ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ 3 ਦਿਨਾਂ ਬਾਅਦ B ਜੁੜਦਾ ਹੈ। ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਤੋਂ ਕੁੱਲ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਦਿਨ ਲੱਗਣਗੇ?

explanation.en:
Split the work into timeline phases.
\[
W_1=r_At_1,\ T_2=\frac{W-W_1}{r_A+r_B}
\]
Subtract the work already completed.
\[
W_1=2\times 3,\quad R=60-6
\]
Use the active rate for the remaining phase.
\[
T=3+\frac{54}{2+5}=10.71
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=3+\frac{60-2\times 3}{2+5}
\]
Answer: 10.71 days

question: A and B work on a job but leave before it is completed. A leaves 2 days early and B leaves 3 days early. If their individual times are 6 and 15 days, how long does the job take?
explanation:
Set up the rate relation for this case.
\[
r_A(T-a)+r_B(T-b)=W
\]
Put the given values into that relation.
\[
10(T-2)+4(T-3)=60
\]
Solve for the asked value.
\[
T=6.57
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=\frac{W+A\times 2+B\times 3}{A+B}
\]
Answer: 6.57 days

\[
10(T-2)+4(T-3)=60
\]
पूछे गए मान के लिए हल करें।
\[
T=6.57
\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:
\[
T=\frac{W+A\times 2+B\times 3}{A+B}
\]
उत्तर: 6.57 दिन

\[

question: Three machines work in parallel and make 12, 15 and 18 parts per hour. For 5 hours, what is the total number of parts?
explanation:
Write output as rate multiplied by active time.
\[
O=\sum r_it_i
\]
Add the outputs of all active agents.
\[
O=12\times 5+15\times 5+18\times 5
\]
Simplify the total output.
\[
O=225
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
O=(r_1+r_2+r_3)t
\]
Answer: 225 items

\[
O=225

question: A and B can work in the ratio 2:3. They complete the job together in 6 days. What is A's time for the same job?
explanation:
Set up the rate relation for this case.
\[
W=(a+b)T
\]
Put the given values into that relation.
\[
W=(2+3)\times 6
\]
Solve for the asked value.
\[
T_A=\frac{30}{2}=15
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T_A=\frac{(a+b)T}{a}=\frac{(2+3)6}{2}=15
\]
Answer: 15 days

\[

\]
पूछे गए मान के लिए हल करें।
\[
T_A=\frac{30}{2}=15
\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:
\[
T_A=\frac{(a+b)T}{a}=\frac{(2+3)6}{2}=15
\]
उत्तर: 15 दिन

question: A contract payment of ₹7200 is shared among A, B and C in the ratio 24:36:40. What amount goes to A?
explanation:
Convert each person's work into contribution units.
\[
Share=\frac{c_i}{\sum c}\times W
\]
Use contribution ratio for the share.
\[
Share=\frac{24}{100}\times 7200
\]
Apply the wage or contract amount.
\[
Share=1728
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
Share=contribution\ ratio\times wage
\]
Answer: ₹1728

मजदूरी या ठेके की राशि लगाएँ।

शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:

stem.en: Two workers receive ₹12000 for a job. Their contributions are proportional to 15:24. How much will A get?
stem.hi: A और B एक काम पूरा कर ₹12000 पाते हैं। उनके काम का अनुपात 15:24 है। A का हिस्सा कितना होगा?
stem.pa: A ਅਤੇ B ਇੱਕ ਕੰਮ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਕੇ ₹12000 ਲੈਂਦੇ ਹਨ। ਉਨ੍ਹਾਂ ਦੇ ਕੰਮ ਦਾ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ 15:24 ਹੈ। A ਦਾ ਹਿੱਸਾ ਕਿੰਨਾ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ?

stem.pa: ਇੱਕ ਮਸ਼ੀਨ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਘੰਟਾ 120 ਸਫ਼ੇ ਛਾਪਦੀ ਹੈ। ਉਹ 5 ਘੰਟੇ ਚੱਲਦੀ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ 90% ਸਫ਼ੇ ਵਰਤਣਯੋਗ ਹਨ। ਵਰਤਣਯੋਗ ਸਫ਼ੇ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਮਿਲਣਗੇ?

explanation.en:
Convert each person's work into contribution units.
\[
O_a=O\times \frac{p}{100}
\]
Use contribution ratio for the share.
\[
O_a=120\times 5\times \frac{90}{100}
\]
Apply the wage or contract amount.
\[
O_a=540
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
O_a=gross\times p/100
\]
Answer: 540 pages

हर व्यक्ति के काम को योगदान इकाइयों में बदलें।

\]
हिस्से के लिए योगदान अनुपात लगाएँ।
\[
O_a=120\times 5\times \frac{90}{100}
\]
मजदूरी या ठेके की राशि लगाएँ।
\[
O_a=540
\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:
\[
O_a=gross\times p/100
\]
उत्तर: 540 पृष्ठ
explanation.pa:
ਹਰ ਵਿਅਕਤੀ ਦੇ ਕੰਮ ਨੂੰ ਯੋਗਦਾਨ ਇਕਾਈਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਬਦਲੋ।
\[
O_a=O\times \frac{p}{100}
\]
ਹਿੱਸੇ ਲਈ ਯੋਗਦਾਨ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਲਗਾਓ।
\[
O_a=120\times 5\times \frac{90}{100}
\]
ਮਜ਼ਦੂਰੀ ਜਾਂ ਠੇਕੇ ਦੀ ਰਕਮ ਲਗਾਓ।

ਉੱਤਰ: 540 ਸਫ਼ੇ

question: A tank is filled by a pipe taking 12 hours and emptied by another pipe taking 36 hours. In how many hours will the tank be filled if both are opened?
explanation:
Write filling rates as positive and emptying rates as negative.
\[
T=\frac{W_l}{r_f-r_e}
\]
Find the effective tank rate.
\[
r=1/12-1/36
\]
Divide the required tank work by that rate.
\[
T=18
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=\frac{W_l}{r_n}
\]
Answer: 18 hours

भरने की दर धनात्मक और खाली करने की दर ऋणात्मक लें।
\[
T=\frac{W_l}{r_f-r_e}
\]
टंकी की प्रभावी दर निकालें।
\[
r=1/12-1/36
\]
आवश्यक टंकी-काम को उसी दर से भाग दें।
\[
T=18
\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:
\[
T=\frac{W_l}{r_n}
\]
उत्तर: 18 घंटे

\]
ਟੈਂਕੀ ਦੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਾਵੀ ਦਰ ਕੱਢੋ।
\[

question: Two filling pipes A and B take 12 and 18 hours respectively. If pipe B is opened 2 hours later, what is the time in hours to fill the tank?
explanation:
Split the work into timeline phases.
\[
W_1=r_At_1,\quad T=t_1+\frac{W-W_1}{r_A+r_B}
\]
Subtract the work already completed.
\[
W_1=3\times 2
\]
Use the active rate for the remaining phase.
\[
T=2+\frac{30}{3+2}=8
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=t_1+\frac{W-W_1}{r_A+r_B}
\]
Answer: 8 hours
explanationHi:
काम को समय-चरणों में बाँटें।
\[
W_1=r_At_1,\quad T=t_1+\frac{W-W_1}{r_A+r_B}
\]
अब तक पूरा हुआ काम घटाएँ।
\[
W_1=3\times 2
\]
शेष चरण के लिए सक्रिय दर लगाएँ।
\[
T=2+\frac{30}{3+2}=8
\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:
\[
T=t_1+\frac{W-W_1}{r_A+r_B}
\]
उत्तर: 8 घंटे

\]

question: A tank is already one-fourth full. A pipe can fill the whole tank in 12 hours. In how many hours will the remaining part be filled?

Write filling rates as positive and emptying rates as negative.
\[

\[
T=9
\]

\[
T=(1-f)F
\]
Answer: 9 hours

auditMeta.stemSkeleton: A filling pipe takes # hours for the tank. After it works for # hours, a leak opens and can empty the tank in # hours. What is the total filling time?

question: A tank has two filling pipes. Pipe A fills it in 12 hours and pipe B in 18 hours. pipe A is closed after 2 hours. What is the total filling time?
explanation:
Split the work into timeline phases.
\[
W_1=(r_A+r_B)t_1,\quad T=t_1+\frac{W-W_1}{r_B}
\]
Subtract the work already completed.
\[
W_1=(3+2)\times 2
\]
Use the active rate for the remaining phase.
\[
T=2+\frac{26}{2}=15
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=t_1+\frac{W-W_1}{r_B}
\]
Answer: 15 hours

\]
अब तक पूरा हुआ काम घटाएँ।
\[
W_1=(3+2)\times 2
\]
शेष चरण के लिए सक्रिय दर लगाएँ।
\[
T=2+\frac{26}{2}=15
\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:
\[
T=t_1+\frac{W-W_1}{r_B}
\]
उत्तर: 15 घंटे

stem.en: One pipe fills a tank in 12 hours, while another empties it in 36 hours. What time is required to fill the tank with both open?
stem.hi: पाइप A टंकी 12 घंटे में भरता है और पाइप B वही टंकी 36 घंटे में खाली करता है। दोनों साथ खोलें तो टंकी कितने घंटे में भरेगी?
stem.pa: ਪਾਈਪ A ਟੈਂਕੀ 12 ਘੰਟਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਭਰਦਾ ਹੈ ਅਤੇ ਪਾਈਪ B ਉਹੀ ਟੈਂਕੀ 36 ਘੰਟਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਖਾਲੀ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਦੋਵੇਂ ਨਾਲ ਖੋਲ੍ਹਣ ਤਾਂ ਟੈਂਕੀ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਘੰਟਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਭਰੇਗੀ?

explanation.en:
Write filling rates as positive and emptying rates as negative.
\[
\frac{1}{B}=\frac{1}{T}-\frac{1}{A}
\]
Find the effective tank rate.
\[
\frac{1}{B}=\frac{1}{8}-\frac{1}{15}
\]
Divide the required tank work by that rate.
\[
B=17.14
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
B=\frac{AT}{A-T}
\]
Answer: 17.14 hours
explanation.hi:
भरने की दर धनात्मक और खाली करने की दर ऋणात्मक लें।

\]
टंकी की प्रभावी दर निकालें।
\[

\]
आवश्यक टंकी-काम को उसी दर से भाग दें।
\[
B=17.14
\]

\[

\]
उत्तर: 17.14 घंटे

\[

\]
ਉੱਤਰ: 17.14 ਘੰਟੇ

question: There is enough food for 24 people for 24 days. What is its duration for 40 people?
explanation:
Convert the stock into consumption units.
\[
M_1D_1=M_2D_2
\]
Subtract the stock already consumed.
\[
24\times 24=40\times D_2
\]
Divide the remaining stock by the new daily use.
\[
D_2=14.4
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
D_2=\frac{24\times 24}{40}
\]
Answer: 14 2/5 days

\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:
\[

\]
उत्तर: 14 2/5 दिन

question: A camp has food for 24 people for 30 days. After 6 days, the camp has 30 people. What is the remaining duration?
explanation:
Convert the stock into consumption units.
\[
D=\frac{S-consumed}{people}
\]
Subtract the stock already consumed.
\[
D=\frac{720-24\times 6}{30}
\]
Divide the remaining stock by the new daily use.
\[
D=19.2
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
D=\frac{S_l}{P_2}
\]
Answer: 19 1/5 days

question: Three typists work together for 6 hours. They complete 12, 15 and 18 pages per hour. How many pages are completed?
explanation:
Write output as rate multiplied by active time.
\[
O=\sum r_it_i
\]
Add the outputs of all active agents.
\[
O=12\times 6+15\times 6+18\times 6
\]
Simplify the total output.
\[
O=270
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
O=(r_1+r_2+r_3)t
\]
Answer: 270 pages

O=270

stem.en: 16 farm workers can harvest a field in 12 days by working 6 hours a day. How many workers are needed to finish it in 18 days by working 8 hours a day?
stem.hi: 16 मजदूर 6 घंटे प्रतिदिन काम कर काम 12 दिन में पूरा करते हैं। 8 घंटे प्रतिदिन पर 18 दिन के लिए मजदूरों की संख्या क्या होगी?
stem.pa: 16 ਮਜ਼ਦੂਰ 6 ਘੰਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਦਿਨ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਕੇ ਕੰਮ 12 ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ। 8 ਘੰਟੇ ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਦਿਨ ਤੇ 18 ਦਿਨਾਂ ਲਈ ਮਜ਼ਦੂਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਕੀ ਹੋਵੇਗੀ?

\[
M_2=8
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
M_2=\frac{16\times 12\times 6}{18\times 8}=8
\]
Answer: 8 workers

question: One worker can do a job in 10 days and another can do it in 16 days. How long will they take together?
explanation:
Take the LCM as total work.
\[
W=LCM(10,16)=80
\]
Find each worker's one-period efficiency.
\[
A=80/10=8,\quad B=80/16=5
\]
Divide total work by the combined efficiency.
\[
T=\frac{80}{8+5}=6.15
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=\frac{10\times 16}{10+16}=6.15
\]
Answer: 6.15 days
explanationHi:
कुल काम के लिए LCM लें।
\[
W=LCM(10,16)=80
\]
प्रत्येक मजदूर की एक-अवधि दक्षता निकालें।
\[
A=80/10=8,\quad B=80/16=5
\]
कुल काम को संयुक्त दक्षता से भाग दें।
\[
T=\frac{80}{8+5}=6.15
\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:
\[
T=\frac{10\times 16}{10+16}=6.15
\]
उत्तर: 6.15 दिन
explanationPa:
ਕੁੱਲ ਕੰਮ ਲਈ LCM ਲਵੋ।
\[

question: Three machines run together. Their hourly outputs are 20, 25 and 30 parts. How many parts are produced in 6, 5, 4 hours respectively?
explanation:
Write output as rate multiplied by active time.
\[
O=\sum r_it_i
\]
Add the outputs of all active agents.
\[
O=20\times 6+25\times 5+30\times 4
\]
Simplify the total output.
\[
O=365
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
O=\sum r_it_i
\]
Answer: 365 items

कुल उत्पादन सरल करें।
\[

\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:

question: A and B can separately complete a job in 18 days and 10 days. What is the time taken when they work together?
explanation:
Take the LCM as total work.
\[
W=LCM(18,10)=90
\]
Find each worker's one-period efficiency.
\[
A=90/18=5,\quad B=90/10=9
\]
Divide total work by the combined efficiency.
\[
T=\frac{90}{5+9}=6.43
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=\frac{18\times 10}{18+10}=6.43
\]
Answer: 6.43 days

question: A group is expected to complete a work in 24 days. It has already worked for 4 days. What fraction remains?
explanation:
Set up the rate relation for this case.
\[
R=1-\frac{t}{T}
\]
Put the given values into that relation.
\[
R=1-\frac{4}{24}
\]
Solve for the asked value.
\[
R=\frac{20}{24}=5/6
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
R=\frac{24-4}{24}=5/6
\]
Answer: 5/6

पूछे गए मान के लिए हल करें।
\[
R=\frac{20}{24}=5/6
\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:
\[
R=\frac{24-4}{24}=5/6
\]
उत्तर: 5/6

B=\frac{8\times 20}{20-8}=13\frac{1}{3}

stem.en: If A's time is 6 days and B's time is 15 days, what ratio of work will they do in equal time?
stem.hi: A काम 6 दिन में और B 15 दिन में पूरा करता है। समान समय में उनके काम का अनुपात क्या होगा?
stem.pa: A ਕੰਮ 6 ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਅਤੇ B 15 ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੂਰਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਇੱਕੋ ਜਿਹੇ ਸਮੇਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਉਹਨਾਂ ਦੇ ਕੰਮ ਦਾ ਅਨੁਪਾਤ ਕੀ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ?

W_A:W_B=\frac{1}{6}:\frac{1}{15}
\]
Put the given values into that relation.
\[

\]
Solve for the asked value.
\[
W_A:W_B=5:2
\]

\[
E=5:2
\]
Answer: 5:2

question: A works alone for 3 days on a job. A's time is 24 days and B's time is 10 days. How many days are needed from the start if B joins afterward?
explanation:
Split the work into timeline phases.
\[
W_1=r_At_1,\ T_2=\frac{W-W_1}{r_A+r_B}
\]
Subtract the work already completed.
\[
W_1=10\times 3,\quad R=240-30
\]
Use the active rate for the remaining phase.
\[
T=3+\frac{210}{10+24}=9.18
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=3+\frac{240-10\times 3}{10+24}
\]
Answer: 9.18 days
explanationHi:
काम को समय-चरणों में बाँटें।
\[
W_1=r_At_1,\ T_2=\frac{W-W_1}{r_A+r_B}
\]
अब तक पूरा हुआ काम घटाएँ।
\[
W_1=10\times 3,\quad R=240-30
\]
शेष चरण के लिए सक्रिय दर लगाएँ।
\[
T=3+\frac{210}{10+24}=9.18
\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:
\[
T=3+\frac{240-10\times 3}{10+24}
\]
उत्तर: 9.18 दिन

question: In a joint job, A and B have individual times 10 and 20 days. A is not present in the last 2 days and B in the last 3 days. What is the completion time?
explanation:
Set up the rate relation for this case.

Put the given values into that relation.

\]

T=\frac{W+A\times 2+B\times 3}{A+B}
\]

stem.pa: A 6 ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਕੰਮ ਦਾ \(\frac{4}{9}\) ਹਿੱਸਾ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। ਪੂਰਾ ਕੰਮ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੂਰਾ ਹੋਵੇਗਾ?

explanation.en:
Set up the rate relation for this case.
\[
T=d\times \frac{q}{p}
\]
Put the given values into that relation.
\[
T=6\times \frac{9}{4}
\]
Solve for the asked value.
\[
T=13.5
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=6\div \frac{4}{9}=13.5
\]
Answer: 13 1/2 days

\[
T=d\times \frac{q}{p}
\]

\[
T=6\times \frac{9}{4}
\]
पूछे गए मान के लिए हल करें।
\[
T=13.5
\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:
\[
T=6\div \frac{4}{9}=13.5
\]
उत्तर: 13 1/2 दिन

ਉੱਤਰ: 13 1/2 ਦਿਨ

auditMeta.stemSkeleton: The fraction \(\frac{#}{#}\) of a job is completed in # days. How many days will the whole job take?

question: A group needs 10 working days to complete a job. If there is a break of 2 days, how many days pass from start to finish?
explanation:
Split the work into timeline phases.
\[
T_{calendar}=T_{active}+T_{idle}
\]
Subtract the work already completed.
\[
T_{active}=\frac{150}{9+6}
\]
Use the active rate for the remaining phase.
\[
T=T_{active}+2=12
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=t_a+t_i
\]
Answer: 12 days

\]
शेष चरण के लिए सक्रिय दर लगाएँ।
\[
T=T_{active}+2=12
\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:
\[
T=t_a+t_i
\]
उत्तर: 12 दिन

T=t_1+\frac{W-W_1}{r_2}

question: After a delay, 72 of 180 records are completed by 12 workers. How many extra workers are needed if the remaining records must be finished in 8 days?
explanation:
Split the work into timeline phases.
\[
N_{extra}=\left\lceil\frac{R}{r\times t}\right\rceil-N_c
\]
Subtract the work already completed.
\[
N_{extra}=\left\lceil\frac{108}{1\times 8}\right\rceil-12
\]
Use the active rate for the remaining phase.
\[
N_{extra}=2
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
N_{extra}=N_r-N_c
\]
Answer: 2 workers
explanationHi:

question: Three machines work in parallel and make 12, 15 and 18 parts per hour. For 6 hours, what is the total number of parts?
explanation:
Write output as rate multiplied by active time.
\[
O=\sum r_it_i
\]
Add the outputs of all active agents.
\[
O=12\times 6+15\times 6+18\times 6
\]
Simplify the total output.
\[
O=270
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
O=(r_1+r_2+r_3)t
\]
Answer: 270 items

\]
कुल उत्पादन सरल करें।
\[
O=270
\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:

\]

pa.question: ਮਸ਼ੀਨ A, B ਅਤੇ C ਪ੍ਰਤੀ ਘੰਟਾ 12, 15 ਅਤੇ 18 ਵਸਤੂਆਂ ਬਣਾਉਂਦੀਆਂ ਹਨ। ਉਹ ਕ੍ਰਮਵਾਰ 6 ਘੰਟੇ ਚੱਲਣ ਤਾਂ ਕੁੱਲ ਕਿੰਨੀਆਂ ਵਸਤੂਆਂ ਬਣਣਗੀਆਂ?

\]
ਕੁੱਲ ਉਤਪਾਦਨ ਸਰਲ ਕਰੋ।
\[
O=270
\]
ਸ਼ਾਰਟਕਟ / ਇਮਤਿਹਾਨੀ ਤਰੀਕਾ:
\[

stem.en: Starting with A, two workers alternate. A completes 8 records and B completes 4 records on their respective turns. What is the completion time in hours for 72 records?
stem.hi: दो मजदूर बारी-बारी काम करते हैं और A शुरू करता है। A हर बारी में 8 फाइलें और B 4 फाइलें करता है। 72 फाइलें कितने घंटों में होंगी?
stem.pa: ਦੋ ਮਜ਼ਦੂਰ ਵਾਰੀ-ਵਾਰੀ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ A ਸ਼ੁਰੂ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। A ਹਰ ਵਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ 8 ਫਾਈਲਾਂ ਅਤੇ B 4 ਫਾਈਲਾਂ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। 72 ਫਾਈਲਾਂ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਘੰਟਿਆਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੋਣਗੀਆਂ?

explanation.en:
Find the work completed in one full cycle.
\[
W_{cycle}=\sum r_i
\]
Count full cycles before the last turn.
\[
W_{cycle}=8+4
\]
Add only the needed part of the final turn.
\[
T=12
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=cycles+final\ turn
\]
Answer: 12 hours

stem.en: Two workers take turns, with A starting. A handles 6 files per turn and B handles 4 files per turn. In how many days will 120 files be finished?
stem.hi: A और B बारी-बारी दिन काम करते हैं और शुरुआत A करता है। A अपनी बारी में 6 फाइलें और B 4 फाइलें करता है। 120 फाइलें कितने दिनों में पूरी होंगी?
stem.pa: A ਅਤੇ B ਵਾਰੀ-ਵਾਰੀ ਦਿਨ ਕੰਮ ਕਰਦੇ ਹਨ ਅਤੇ ਸ਼ੁਰੂਆਤ A ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। A ਆਪਣੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਵਿੱਚ 6 ਫਾਈਲਾਂ ਅਤੇ B 4 ਫਾਈਲਾਂ ਕਰਦਾ ਹੈ। 120 ਫਾਈਲਾਂ ਕਿੰਨੇ ਦਿਨਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਪੂਰੀਆਂ ਹੋਣਗੀਆਂ?

explanation.en:
Find the work completed in one full cycle.
\[
W_{cycle}=\sum r_i
\]
Count full cycles before the last turn.
\[
W_{cycle}=6+4
\]
Add only the needed part of the final turn.
\[
T=24
\]
Shortcut / Exam Method:
\[
T=cycles+final\ turn
\]
Answer: 24 days
explanation.hi:
एक पूरे चक्र में हुआ काम निकालें।
\[
W_{cycle}=\sum r_i
\]
अंतिम बारी से पहले पूरे चक्र गिनें।
\[
W_{cycle}=6+4
\]
अंतिम बारी का केवल आवश्यक भाग जोड़ें।
\[
T=24
\]
शॉर्टकट / परीक्षा विधि:
\[
T=cycles+final\ turn
\]
उत्तर: 24 दिन
explanation.pa:
ਇੱਕ ਪੂਰੇ ਚੱਕਰ ਵਿੱਚ ਹੋਇਆ ਕੰਮ ਕੱਢੋ।
\[
W_{cycle}=\sum r_i
\]
ਆਖਰੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਤੋਂ ਪਹਿਲਾਂ ਪੂਰੇ ਚੱਕਰ ਗਿਣੋ।
\[
W_{cycle}=6+4
\]
ਆਖਰੀ ਵਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਕੇਵਲ ਲੋੜੀਂਦਾ ਭਾਗ ਜੋੜੋ।
\[
T=24
\]
ਸ਼ਾਰਟਕਟ / ਇਮਤਿਹਾਨੀ ਤਰੀਕਾ:
\[
T=cycles+final\ turn
\]
ਉੱਤਰ: 24 ਦਿਨ
